authorized_change.reason: The frozen TreeTime homoplasy CLI prints only the first n repeated mutation types, with n defaulting to 10, while the frozen benchmark endpoint is recurrent genomic sites and includes scenarios with 20 or 30 recurrent sites. The already-frozen TreeTime ancestral workflow uses the same joint maximum-likelihood ancestral reconstruction engine and exposes complete reconstructed branch changes without this top-n reporting limit.
requirements: Do not use benchmark truth to derive or validate TreeTime calls.
Retain the frozen TreeTime ancestral reconstruction parameters and executable version.
Define a TreeTime recurrent-site call as a genomic position with at least two normalized reconstructed branch changes from the TreeTime ancestral output.
Set reported_recurrence_count_if_available to the number of normalized reconstructed branch changes at that position.
Count recurrence by genomic position regardless of whether repeated changes have identical or different ancestral/derived state pairs.
Do not treat TreeTime homoplasy stdout top-n reporting as the scored site call set.
Update the TreeTime environment/output contract to record that homoplasy scoring is derived from the frozen ancestral reconstruction output.
Add focused synthetic validation covering non-recurrent, parallel-like, convergent-like and reversal-like repeated branch events.
Do not execute any of the frozen 150 benchmark scenarios during implementation or validation.

triggering_observation.ancestral_and_homoplasy_reconstruction_e: Both use TreeAnc joint maximum-likelihood ancestral reconstruction under the frozen non-marginal settings; probabilistic and ml select the same joint reconstruction implementation.
triggering_observation.observed_risk: Scoring the homoplasy CLI stdout would truncate calls and reports repeated mutation types rather than the complete recurrent-site set.
